manifest_name: Phase 6E Physical Hydrology & Topographic Routing Manifest
study_area: Bengaluru Urban provisional study domain (1,170 cells, EPSG:6933)
methodology: Deterministic D8 Flow Routing, Topographic Wetness Index (TWI), Priority-Flood Sink Filling, Rational Runoff Coefficient
driving_nwp_source: Authentic NOAA GFS 0.25-deg AWS Open Data (Stage 6A)

topographic_routing_static_features.description: Slope gradients, TWI, sink depths, upstream contributing area, and runoff coefficients for all 1,170 cells

dynamic_hydrological_inundation_potentia.description: Daily 24h effective runoff depth, HIPI score, and physical flood risk tier coupled with genuine NOAA GFS forecasts

hydrology_ground_truth_validation.description: Cross-validation of physical HIPI index against verified positive and negative ground truth incidents
